context: Tests the primary happy path: every best-practice default is applied and the brief's gaps (version, namespace) are handled explicitly.

checklist.name: Handles missing requirements
checklist.description: Asks for, or explicitly states an assumption about, the target Kubernetes version and the namespace

checklist.name: Pins the image tag
checklist.description: Uses image tag 2.4.1 and does not use `latest`

checklist.name: Sets resources
checklist.description: Sets resource requests and limits on the container

checklist.name: Configures probes
checklist.description: Configures a livenessProbe on /health and a readinessProbe on /ready, both on port 8080

checklist.name: Runs as non-root
checklist.description: Sets a non-root securityContext (runAsNonRoot or a non-zero runAsUser)

checklist.name: Explicit namespace
checklist.description: Sets a namespace explicitly on every namespace-scoped resource

checklist.name: Recommended labels
checklist.description: Applies the app.kubernetes.io name and instance labels consistently on all resources

checklist.name: Selectors match
checklist.description: The Service selector matches the Deployment pod template labels exactly

checklist.name: Current API versions
checklist.description: Uses apps/v1 for the Deployment and v1 for the Service

checklist.name: Internal Service
checklist.description: Uses a ClusterIP Service because access is cluster-internal only

checklist.name: Validates before delivery
checklist.description: Runs the validation workflow (yamllint, kubeconform, dry-run) or reports its results before delivering the YAML

checklist.name: Summary and next steps
checklist.description: Delivers a brief summary of key choices and next steps such as kubectl apply, get and describe

checklist.name: No unsafe defaults
checklist.description: The delivered YAML contains none of: the latest tag, missing limits, missing probes
